instructions.zh: 在 Steam 库中右键点击龙之信条 2，选择「管理」→「浏览本地文件」。
instructions.en: Right-click Dragon's Dogma 2 in your Steam library and choose Manage → Browse local files.

instructions.zh: 在打开的游戏文件夹中，找到 re2_framework_log.txt，选中后拖入日志上传区域。它与游戏 EXE 位于同一层，不在 reframework 文件夹内。
instructions.en: In the game folder, select re2_framework_log.txt and drag it into the log upload area. It is next to the game EXE, not inside the reframework folder.

instructions.zh: 只有作者要求时，才需添加同目录的 re2_fw_config.txt；排查崩溃时，作者也可能需要 reframework_crash.dmp。填写昵称后点击发送。没有日志时，请告知作者。
instructions.en: Add re2_fw_config.txt from the same folder only if the author requests it. For a crash, the author may also request reframework_crash.dmp. Enter your nickname and click Send. If there is no log, tell the author.
